withdrawn_claims: two-sided exact sign p-value for canonical support C5-C1
two-sided exact sign p-value for executable oracle/headroom C5-C1
correction.reason: C1 is a subset of C5, so both endpoints are monotone non-decreasing by construction. The equal-probability sign null assigns mass to decreases that the design excludes.
correction.retained_valid_test: The standalone temperature-0.7-minus-temperature-0 support contrast is non-nested and retains its two-sided exact sign test.

report: two-sided 95% task-cluster bootstrap percentile interval for estimation
one-sided 95% task-cluster bootstrap lower confidence bound

trajectory_dose_response.trajectory_success: at least one executable canonical candidate among that trajectory's 16 slots
trajectory_dose_response.extrapolation_guard: n greater than 5 is model-based extrapolation under conditional iid stochastic trajectories and is not new observed evidence

rescue_robustness.report: number of the five stochastic trajectories containing an executable canonical candidate

report: oracle over five stochastic final answers
mean oracle over one complete stochastic 16-slot trajectory
final_only_comparison.guard: candidate counts are intentionally unequal and the result is descriptive

matched_slot_comparison.within_trajectory: mean oracle over all 16 slots of one stochastic trajectory
matched_slot_comparison.cross_trajectory: expected oracle from 16 uniformly sampled slots allocated 4/3/3/3/3 across the five stochastic trajectories, averaged over which trajectory receives four slots
matched_slot_comparison.calculation: exact hypergeometric no-valid probability within each cached trajectory
matched_slot_comparison.guard: cached conditional comparison; not a randomized architecture experiment

independence_guard: The 120 trajectories are repeated observations nested within 20 tasks. Task generalization uncertainty resamples tasks, not trajectories as independent units.

privacy_reframe.binary_executor_signal: g_U=1 and Delta_c=1 for a valid-versus-invalid candidate comparison, so rho_U=1 conditional on a mixed candidate pool
privacy_reframe.adjacency: candidate-score replacement adjacency: one candidate's clipped binary validity bit may change while the candidate texts and all other utilities are trusted
privacy_reframe.release: only the selected candidate index/output is released
privacy_reframe.scope: selector-level DP only; the selecting trusted party observes candidates and executor utilities
